channel.title: Penta AI Guides
channel.description: Practical guides to website fonts, colors, CSS and design systems.

item.title: How to Extract a Design System from an Existing Website
item.description: Audit colors, typography, spacing, and component states on a live website. Build a useful token inventory while separating observations from assumptions.

item.title: How to Find the Font on a Website in Chrome
item.description: Identify a website’s real rendered font, size, weight, and line height in Chrome. Learn why font stacks and screenshot guesses can mislead you.

item.title: How to Extract a Website Color Palette That You Can Use
item.description: Find a website’s colors in Chrome, separate CSS values from screenshot samples, and turn the result into a named palette with contrast checks.

item.title: How to Inspect CSS on a Website with Chrome DevTools
item.description: Find the CSS behind any page element, understand computed styles, and check layouts, hover states, and responsive behavior in Chrome DevTools.

item.title: Turn Website Design Tokens into a Tailwind CSS v4 Theme
item.description: Map inspected colors and radii into semantic CSS variables and a Tailwind v4 theme, with an original example and component validation checklist.

item.title: DESIGN.md: A Practical Design Brief for AI Coding
item.description: Use this DESIGN.md template to give an AI coding assistant clear design tokens, layout rules, component states, evidence, and review criteria.

item.title: Web Font Not Loading? A Chrome Debugging Checklist
item.description: Find why a web font falls back in Chrome. Check font requests, CSS paths, family names, weights and missing characters with a repeatable debugging workflow.

item.title: How to Check Website Color Contrast, State by State
item.description: Audit text, buttons and focus indicators against their real backgrounds. Learn contrast thresholds, inspect transparent colors and record actionable fixes.

item.title: Why Your CSS Is Not Applying: Debug the Cascade
item.description: Find why a CSS declaration loses without adding random important flags. Trace selector matches, cascade layers, specificity, inheritance and source order.

item.title: CSS Grid vs Flexbox: Choose by the Layout You Need
item.description: Choose Grid or Flexbox using card alignment, wrapping and content behavior. Compare practical layouts, nested patterns and common sizing problems.

item.title: How to Find and Fix Horizontal Overflow on Mobile
item.description: Track down the element making a page wider than its viewport. Fix grid minimums, long content, media and fixed widths without hiding useful content.

item.title: How to Build a CSS Spacing Scale from Real Components
item.description: Turn inconsistent margins, padding and gaps into a small CSS spacing scale. Audit component roles, handle exceptions and validate narrow layouts.

item.title: Fluid Typography with CSS clamp(): A Worked Example
item.description: Create headings that scale between readable limits with CSS clamp. Calculate a fluid range, combine rem and viewport units, and test zoom behavior.

item.title: How to Inspect and Rebuild a CSS Box Shadow
item.description: Read CSS shadow layers, offsets, blur and spread. Rebuild subtle card elevation, identify clipping, and test the result on the intended background.

item.title: Build a Consistent Border Radius System in CSS
item.description: Choose useful radius tokens for buttons, cards and nested surfaces. Inspect real corners, avoid clipping focus rings, and document intentional exceptions.

item.title: CSS Variable Fallbacks: Missing Values vs Invalid Values
item.description: Debug CSS custom properties by tracing scope, inheritance and var fallbacks. Learn why an existing value of the wrong type can still break a declaration.

item.title: Build Dark Mode with Semantic CSS Color Tokens
item.description: Create light and dark themes with semantic CSS variables. Respect system preferences, distinguish color-scheme, and test surfaces, controls and contrast.

item.title: SVG vs PNG for Website Icons: A Practical Choice
item.description: Choose an icon format based on scaling, detail, styling and delivery. Compare SVG and PNG, set dimensions, and check sharpness at actual display sizes.

item.title: Accessible Button States: Default, Focus and Disabled
item.description: Specify buttons beyond the default screenshot. Cover keyboard focus, hover, pressed and disabled behavior with native HTML and a practical review matrix.

item.title: A Design Handoff Checklist Developers Can Verify
item.description: Hand off a website with clear tokens, assets, responsive rules and interaction states. Use acceptance criteria that can be checked in the running interface.

item.title: CSS Container Queries: Make Cards Fit Their Own Space
item.description: Build reusable cards that adapt to their container instead of the viewport. Set up containment, choose a useful breakpoint and debug queries that do not apply.

item.title: Position Sticky Not Working? Check These Constraints
item.description: Debug sticky headers and sidebars by checking offsets, scrolling ancestors, available height and stacking. Fix the constraint instead of switching blindly to fixed.

item.title: Unitless Line Height in CSS: Why Inheritance Matters
item.description: Choose readable line spacing and understand unitless inheritance. Compare number and length values, inspect nested text, and test user spacing overrides.

item.title: Object Fit Cover vs Contain: Fix Website Image Cropping
item.description: Choose cover or contain based on what an image must preserve. Define the image box, adjust the focal point and test portrait, landscape and transparent assets.

item.title: CSS Logical Properties: Layouts That Follow Text Direction
item.description: Replace direction-dependent spacing with logical CSS properties. Understand inline and block axes, test RTL content, and preserve intentional physical placement.

item.title: Responsive Images: How srcset and sizes Work Together
item.description: Serve suitable image resolutions with srcset and sizes. Match the declared image slot to your layout, reserve space and verify the selected resource in Chrome.

item.title: Z-Index Not Working? Trace the Stacking Context
item.description: Debug a menu hidden behind another component. Trace ancestor stacking contexts, distinguish clipping from layering and repair the relevant stacking boundary.

item.title: CSS Margin Collapse: Why Vertical Gaps Look Wrong
item.description: Understand collapsing block margins with a small worked example. Separate sibling spacing from parent padding and choose a repair that matches the layout.

item.title: Align Card Titles and Footers with CSS Subgrid
item.description: Use row subgrid to align card sections across a collection without fixed text heights. Build a fallback and test long titles, missing content and narrow layouts.

item.title: CSS Aspect Ratio: Size the Box Before Fitting the Image
item.description: Use aspect-ratio for consistent media slots. Understand automatic dimensions, content constraints and the separate role of object-fit with practical CSS examples.

item.title: How to Inspect CSS Pseudo-Elements and Missing Decorations
item.description: Find styles created by before and after pseudo-elements. Check generated content, box dimensions, positioning and clipping without changing meaningful HTML text.

item.title: CSS Multiple Backgrounds: Put the Overlay in the Right Layer
item.description: Build a readable image banner with separate gradient and photo layers. Match background-size and position lists, and avoid shorthand resets during debugging.

item.title: Respect Reduced Motion Without Hiding Interface Feedback
item.description: Use prefers-reduced-motion to reduce nonessential movement while keeping clear state changes. Review CSS transitions, JavaScript animation and loading feedback.

item.title: Build a Skip Link That Moves Keyboard Users to the Content
item.description: Add a visible-on-focus skip link and verify its target, focus behavior and placement above navigation. Test the full keyboard path on real page templates.

item.title: Native HTML Dialog: A Keyboard and Focus Checklist
item.description: Build a small modal with the dialog element, showModal and an explicit close action. Check initial focus, Escape, background interaction and focus restoration.

item.title: Form Labels vs Placeholders: Keep the Field’s Purpose Visible
item.description: Associate visible labels with form fields, keep examples in helpful text and test repeated components for unique IDs. Build an email field that stays understandable.

item.title: Accessible Form Errors: Connect the Message to the Field
item.description: Write actionable validation messages and associate them with inputs. Preserve help text, mark invalid fields and test recovery after a failed form submission.

item.title: How to Write Alt Text for UI Screenshots and Icons
item.description: Choose image alternatives by purpose: informative screenshots, decorative artwork and linked icons. Keep complex instructions in nearby text instead of overloaded alt text.

item.title: Responsive Data Tables Without Losing Row and Column Context
item.description: Keep data tables readable on narrow screens with semantic headers and a scrollable region. Test keyboard scrolling, long values and relationships between cells.

item.title: Wrap Long URLs and Filenames with CSS overflow-wrap
item.description: Stop long strings from breaking cards while preserving readable text. Compare anywhere, break-word, nowrap and deliberate truncation with a filename example.

item.title: Variable Font Axes: Match the File to Your CSS
item.description: Use a variable font’s real weight range and supported axes. Prefer standard CSS properties for common axes and verify the rendered face before tuning typography.

item.title: When to Preload a Web Font—and How to Verify It Helps
item.description: Preload a genuinely critical font with matching request settings. Check for duplicate downloads, unused hints and competition with other early page resources.

item.title: CSS Print Styles: Make Guides Readable on Paper and PDF
item.description: Create a focused print stylesheet for article pages. Remove repeated chrome, preserve meaningful content and inspect page breaks, code blocks and table overflow.

item.title: Style Link Underlines Without Losing Readability
item.description: Tune underline offset and thickness for inline links. Test wrapped text, descenders and focus states while preserving a clear visual cue beyond link color.

item.title: Keep Anchor Headings Visible Below a Sticky Header
item.description: Fix headings hidden after anchor navigation with scroll margins or container padding. Test direct fragment URLs, changing header heights and keyboard navigation.

item.title: Use currentColor to Keep SVG Icons in Sync with Text
item.description: Make inline SVG icons inherit a component’s color through fill or stroke. Diagnose fixed colors, external image boundaries and accidental changes to multicolor artwork.
